description: Find actionable work across the Acta record. Surfaces contested records needing evidence, claims with no evidence, predictions approaching resolution, and recently active topics. This is the "where am I needed?" tool.

mode.description: contested: records in contested state. needs_evidence: claims/predictions with no linked evidence. approaching_resolution: predictions with resolution dates within 30 days. recent_activity: topics with recent entries.
